{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: UI tests

# Runs the Appium UI tests (tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests) on an iOS simulator and an Android emulator for
# every pull request into main, after every merge into main, and on demand.
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

# A new push to a pull request cancels the run for the previous one; every merge into main is checked.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# The SDK, the workload set and Xcode the tests were last checked with. Each .NET for iOS version needs one Xcode
# version (the workload set 10.0.401.1 brings .NET for iOS 27, which needs Xcode 27), so update them together.
env:
  DOTNET_SDK_VERSION: 10.0.400
  DOTNET_WORKLOAD_VERSION: 10.0.400.1
  XCODE_VERSION: '26.6'

jobs:
  ios:
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      UITEST_PLATFORM: ios
      UITEST_DEVICE: iPhone 17
      UITEST_PLATFORM_VERSION: '26.5'
      # The simulator the iOS baselines were recorded on, so the screenshots are compared too.
      UITEST_SCREENSHOTS: 'on'
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - name: Select Xcode
      run: sudo xcode-select --switch /Applications/Xcode_${{ env.XCODE_VERSION }}.app
    # The first boot of a simulator takes minutes: it boots while the next steps run.
    - name: Start booting the simulator
      run: |
        udid=$(xcrun simctl list devices available --json | jq -r \
          --arg runtime "com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimRuntime.iOS-${UITEST_PLATFORM_VERSION//./-}" --arg name "$UITEST_DEVICE" \
          '.devices[$runtime][]? | select(.name == $name) | .udid')
        if [ -z "$udid" ]; then
          echo "::error::There is no $UITEST_DEVICE simulator with iOS $UITEST_PLATFORM_VERSION on this runner."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "SIMULATOR_UDID=$udid" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        xcrun simctl boot "$udid"
    - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
      with:
        dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_SDK_VERSION }}
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
      with:
        node-version: 22
    - name: Install .NET MAUI
      run: dotnet workload install maui --version ${{ env.DOTNET_WORKLOAD_VERSION }}
    - name: Install Appium
      working-directory: tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests
      run: npm ci
    # Otherwise Appium builds it when the first test starts, which together with the boot takes longer than
    # the tests wait for the app to start.
    - name: Build WebDriverAgent
      working-directory: tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests
      env:
        APPIUM_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests
      run: npx appium driver run xcuitest build-wda --name "$UITEST_DEVICE" --sdk "$UITEST_PLATFORM_VERSION"
    - name: Build the host app
      run: dotnet build tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests.HostApp -f net10.0-ios -c Debug
    - name: Wait for the simulator
      run: xcrun simctl bootstatus "$SIMULATOR_UDID"
    - name: Run the UI tests
      run: dotnet test tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests --logger trx --logger "console;verbosity=normal"
    # Shows the results of every test in the run's summary. It writes the job summary rather than a check run,
    # so it needs no write permission and works for pull requests from forks too. The test step already fails
    # the job when a test fails.
    - name: Publish the test results
      uses: dorny/test-reporter@v3
      if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
      with:
        name: UI tests (iOS)
        report-title: UI tests (iOS)
        path: tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests/TestResults/*.trx
        reporter: dotnet-trx
        fail-on-error: false
        fail-on-empty: false
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
      if: always()
      with:
        name: ui-tests-ios
        path: tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests/TestResults/

  android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      UITEST_PLATFORM: android
      # The emulator is not the device the Android baselines were recorded on, so only the behavior is checked.
      UITEST_SCREENSHOTS: 'off'
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
    - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
      with:
        dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_SDK_VERSION }}
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
      with:
        node-version: 22
    - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
      with:
        distribution: microsoft
        java-version: 21
    - name: Enable KVM for the emulator
      run: |
        echo 'KERNEL=="kvm", GROUP="kvm", MODE="0666", OPTIONS+="static_node=kvm"' | sudo tee /etc/udev/rules.d/99-kvm4all.rules
        sudo udevadm control --reload-rules
        sudo udevadm trigger --name-match=kvm
    - name: Install .NET MAUI
      run: dotnet workload install maui-android --version ${{ env.DOTNET_WORKLOAD_VERSION }}
    - name: Install Appium
      working-directory: tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests
      run: npm ci
    - name: Build the host app
      run: dotnet build tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests.HostApp -f net10.0-android -c Debug
    - name: Run the UI tests on an emulator
      uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
      with:
        api-level: 35
        arch: x86_64
        target: google_apis
        # A phone the size of the Pixel 9 the tests were written on, so the state texts under the calendar, which
        # the tests read, fit on the screen.
        profile: pixel_7
        cores: 4
        disable-animations: true
        # The emulator is slow on the runner, and system apps such as the launcher stop responding at times. Their
        # "isn't responding" dialogs would cover the app, so they are turned off and the one already open is closed.
        script: |
          adb shell settings put global hide_error_dialogs 1
          adb shell am broadcast -a android.intent.action.CLOSE_SYSTEM_DIALOGS
          dotnet test tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests --logger trx --logger "console;verbosity=normal"
    - name: Publish the test results
      uses: dorny/test-reporter@v3
      if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
      with:
        name: UI tests (Android)
        report-title: UI tests (Android)
        path: tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests/TestResults/*.trx
        reporter: dotnet-trx
        fail-on-error: false
        fail-on-empty: false
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
      if: always()
      with:
        name: ui-tests-android
        path: tests/Plugin.Maui.Calendar.UITests/TestResults/",
  "rationale": "The workflow already cancels superseded runs for pull requests via concurrency.cancel-in-progress, but only for pull_request events. Pushes to main share a concurrency group (keyed on github.ref) yet do not cancel in-progress runs, so repeated pushes to main can queue duplicate work. Extending cancel-in-progress to true applies the P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern (cancel superseded runs) to all triggers while preserving the existing per-branch/PR partitioning of the concurrency group. This is a minimal one-line change that keeps all jobs, steps, tests, timeouts, and artifacts unchanged, and it does not weaken permissions or add network access, secrets, or deployment operations.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
